turns.replyText:
Hi Nora, I’m Nova AI, Fashion Nova’s AI customer care assistant. I’m not a human.

I can help with a damaged-item report, but I’ll need the order number (or the 9-character confirmation code from the checkout/thank-you page) so I can pull up the right order. Which one do you have?

turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyText:
Yes. A damaged or defective item shouldn’t be handled as a standard return through the returns portal.

Instead, report it to support within 14 days of delivery and include clear photos of:
- the damaged area on the item
- the packing slip (if you still have it)

Once you tell me the order number, I can pull it up and tell you the next step.
